events.title: The Siege of Vienna Begins
events.description: Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent led a vast army to the walls of Vienna. He hoped to take the Habsburg capital and push Ottoman power deeper into Central Europe.
events.significance: The city held out through autumn weather and supply problems, and the Ottomans withdrew. The siege marked the high-water mark of Ottoman expansion into Central Europe.

events.title: Mexico Achieves Independence from Spain
events.description: The Army of the Three Guarantees marched into Mexico City, formally ending nearly eleven years of struggle against Spanish colonial rule.
events.significance: Mexico became a sovereign nation, and the event reshaped the map of North America and the end of Spain's empire on the continent.

events.title: Germany, Italy and Japan Sign the Tripartite Pact
events.description: In Berlin, the three powers signed a ten-year military and economic alliance. It pledged mutual assistance if any of them was attacked by a country not yet in the war.
events.significance: The pact formally created the Axis alliance and was meant to deter the United States from entering World War II. The world's conflicts were now linked across Europe and Asia.

events.title: China's First Spacewalk
events.description: Astronaut Zhai Zhigang stepped outside the Shenzhou 7 spacecraft and floated in orbit for about fifteen minutes, waving a Chinese flag.
events.significance: China became the third country to carry out an independent spacewalk, after the Soviet Union and the United States. The feat was a major step in its human spaceflight program.
